blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
. We introduce an approach for collection-grounded B-roll sequence generation. Given a user’s video collection, a directive given in natural language, and a target duration, the goal is to produce a multi-shot sequence that complements the user’s primary footage (A-roll) while preserving the collection’s characters, settings, objects, and style.
This task is challenging as one must choose the visual evidence from hours of captured footage that should guide the generation of each shot in the sequence.
We address this challenge with MemComposer, a three-stage system that turns raw footage into a structured memory with visual references (characters, settings, objects, and style) and uses it to plan, retrieve, and generate grounded B-roll sequences.
First, in a one-time offline stage, MemComposer  constructs an entity-centric memory from raw video.
Second, it uses the memory and user directive to plan a grounded sequence and retrieve conditioning frames for each shot.
Third, it iteratively generates and critiques the sequence to enforce identity, setting, and sequence-level consistency.
We evaluate MemComposer  in a user preference study along two dimensions: prompt adherence and visual alignment to the user’s collection. Against an ungrounded text-to-video planner, MemComposer  wins 60.0% of prompt-adherence and 92.8% of visual-alignment comparisons, showing the grounding benefit of collection memory and reference retrieval.
Against retrieval-only sequences assembled from captured footage, MemComposer  wins 94.5% of prompt-adherence comparisons, showing the value of generating missing shots, while retrieval-only sequences are preferred for visual alignment in 58.2% of comparisons. Project page: https://cusuh.github.io/MemComposer

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Picture a documentary filmmaker reviewing forty hours of interview footage. The A-roll is there: talking heads, emotional close-ups, the raw story. What’s needed now is B-roll, the companion visual footage that highlights and augments the narrative: a wide shot of the neighborhood the subject grew up in, a close-up of hands turning the pages of a photo album, a sunset over the factory that closed down. Some of these shots exist somewhere in the captured footage, others were never filmed at all. Traditionally, the only options are to go back and shoot (expensive, sometimes impossible) or settle for what you have. Figure 1 shows examples of what we would like to do instead: generate new B-roll that looks like it belongs in the same visual world as the captured content.
blocks.zh: 拍摄一部纪录片, A卷就在那里:说话的头,情感的特写,原始的故事. 现在需要的是B-roll, 伴奏的视觉镜头突出并充实了叙事:一幅宽广的画面, 其中一些镜头存在于拍摄到的片段的某处,另一些镜头则从未拍摄过. 传统上,唯一的选择是回去拍摄(费用高昂,有时不可能)或满足你拥有的东西. 图1显示了我们想做什么的例子:生成新的B卷,看起来它和捕获的内容一样属于同一个视觉世界.

blocks.en: This limitation is familiar to anyone who edits video. Content creators build compelling videos by first capturing content, then editing it into shape: trimming, sequencing, and layering A-roll and B-roll into a final piece. A lot of planning goes into the capture process precisely because of this constraint, but the framework limits artistic freedom during editing. An editor may want to show a scene from a different angle, remove visual artifacts like a shaky camera, or imagine an entirely new shot with the same characters and background.
blocks.zh: 任何编辑视频的人都熟悉这种限制。 内容创建者通过首先捕获内容,然后将其编辑成形状来构建具有说服力的视频:修剪,排序,以及将A-roll和B-roll分层成最终作品. 许多规划正是因为这个限制而进入捕捉过程,但框架在编辑过程中限制了艺术自由. 编辑者可能希望从不同的角度展示一个场景,移除像摇晃的相机那样的视觉文物,或者想象一个完全新镜头,其人物和背景都是一样的.

blocks.en:
Image and video generative models offer a way out of this bind, expanding flexibility during the editing process. However, generation should not operate independently of the captured content; the captured footage gives context to what should be generated.
While conditioning generation models with keyframes from the collection is a powerful interface, it shifts the burden to the creator, who must manually find and curate the right references for every generated shot.
Such manual curation does not scale when collections are large (hours of footage) and creators need many missing shots.
A user should be able to identify an A-roll insertion point, give a high-level directive referencing particular characters or scenes in the captured content, and the system should know how to generate new footage in context. The generated footage should respect the overall look and storyline while faithfully preserving the specific identities of characters, the layout of scenes, and distinct scene elements.
blocks.zh:
图像和视频基因模型为摆脱这种束缚提供了一条出路,在编辑过程中扩大了灵活性。 然而,生成不应独立于所捕获的内容运行;所捕获的镜头给出了应当生成的内容的背景.
虽然用收藏中的键框来调节生成模型是一个强大的界面,但它将负担转移给创造者,创造者必须手动找到并管理每个生成镜头的正确引用.
当收藏量大(摄像时数小时),而创作者需要许多缺失镜头时,这种手动的曲法不会尺度化.
用户应当能够识别A-roll插入点,给出高级指令,引用所捕获内容中的特定字符或场景,系统应当知道如何在上下文中生成新的镜头. 生成的镜头应尊重整体外观和故事线,同时忠实地保留人物的具体身份,场景的布局以及不同的场景元素.

blocks.en: In this work, we take on B-roll generation in context of user captured footage: given a corpus of captured footage and a high-level user directive describing the desired sequence, produce a sequence of B-roll clips that are visually grounded in the source material. The problem comes up frequently in practice: a content creator has incomplete coverage, a documentary filmmaker is working from archival footage that cannot be reshot, a video editor is assembling a memory piece from scattered home videos. In each case, the existing footage does not cover the story.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们结合用户捕获的镜头来进行B卷生成:鉴于一系列被捕获的镜头以及描述所期望的序列的高级别用户指令,制作一组B卷的片段,这些片段以视像方式植入源材料. 问题经常出现在实际中:内容创作者的报道不完整,纪录片制片人正在利用无法重拍的档案片段工作,视频编辑正在从分散的家用视频中收集记忆片。 在每一种情况下,现有的镜头都不覆盖故事.

blocks.en: Getting this right requires solving three problems: how we represent, retrieve, and generate guided by source content. (i) The corpus must be indexed by entities, not moments. Generation needs to know that the person in clip 3 and the person in clip 27 are the same individual, what their permanent features look like from multiple angles, and which frames carry the strongest identity signal for conditioning. (ii) Retrieval must serve generation, not understanding. The right reference frame is not the most semantically similar one but the one with the right view angle, identity clarity, and level of detail to condition a generative model for a shot that does not yet exist. (iii) Even with good representation and retrieval, independently generated shots can fail as a sequence. Characters drift in appearance across shots, narrative flow breaks, and no single shot’s quality score can detect these failures in isolation. Maintaining consistency requires iterative judging at multiple scales, where per-shot and sequence-level assessments drive targeted regeneration.
blocks.zh: 实现这一权利需要解决三个问题:我们如何代表、检索和以源内容为指导生成。 (一) 委托书必须按实体编制索引,而不是按时间编制索引。 世代需要知道剪辑3中的人和剪辑27中的人是同一个个体,他们永久的特征从多个角度看是什么样子,哪个帧带有最强的身份信号用于调节. (二)检索必须服务于生成,而非理解. 正确的参考框架并不是最相似的,而是一个具有正确视角,身份清晰度和详细度的参考框架,用以为尚不存在的镜头设定基因模型的条件. (三)即使表现和检索良好,独立生成的镜头也可以作为一个序列失败. 人物在外表上漂浮在镜头间,叙事流断,没有一个镜头的质量分数能够孤立地发现这些故障. 保持一致性需要在多个尺度上进行迭代判断,在这种尺度下,按镜头和顺序进行的评估将推动目标再生。

blocks.en: Prior work addresses pieces of this problem but not the whole. Retrieval-augmented generation ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2025a ; Shalev-Arkushin et al., 2026 ) retrieves from generic databases without entity indexing and operates one image at a time, so identity cannot persist across shots. Multi-shot storyboard and long-form video systems ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) maintain consistency within their own generated outputs but assume small curated reference sets or build memory from synthetic frames. Identity-preserving video models ( Yuan et al., 2025b ; Wei et al., 2024 ) generate faithful single clips but have no corpus-level memory connecting shots. B-roll editing tools ( Zhou et al., 2026c ; Sandoval-Castaneda et al., 2025 ) assemble sequences from existing clips but cannot produce a shot that was never filmed.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作涉及这一问题,但不是整个问题。 检索到的一代(Chen等人,2023年;Yuan等人,2025年a;Shalev-Arkushin等人,2026年)从通用数据库中检索到,没有实体索引,一次操作一个图像,所以身份不能在镜头之间持续存在. 多镜头的故事板和长形视频系统(周 al等人,2024年;黄.等人,2026年;赵 Zhao等人,2024年)在自己生成的输出中保持一致性,但承担了小编曲的参考集或从合成帧中建立内存. 身份保存视频模型(Yuan等人,2025b;Wei等人,2024)生成忠实的单片段,但没有实体级记忆连接镜头. B-roll编辑工具(Zhou等人,2026c;Sandoval-Castaneda等人,2025年)从现有剪辑组装序列,但不能产生从未拍摄过的镜头.

blocks.en: Generation guided by a video corpus, it turns out, requires a different kind of visual memory than understanding a video corpus does. Understanding needs semantic summaries while generation needs identity-preserving, appearance-anchored references that can directly condition a generative model. We need a memory that knows not just “there is a person in this scene” but “this is Maria, she has short gray hair and a red scarf, and here are the frames where her face is clearly visible from multiple angles.”
blocks.zh: 以录像机为指南的一代 需要不同的视觉记忆 而不是理解录像机 理解需要语义摘要,而生成则需要保存身份,外观的参考,可以直接对基因模型进行条件化. 我们需要一个不仅知道“这里有一个人”的记忆,而且“这是玛丽亚,她有短灰色的头发和一条红色的围巾,这里是她的脸从多个角度明显可见的框框。 “

blocks.en: We introduce MemComposer, a system for generating B-roll sequences that are faithful to a user’s high-level directive and the visual world of their footage. Our contributions are threefold: (1) We construct a structured visual memory that indexes a video corpus by entities (characters, settings, actions, props), consolidating identity across clips and preserving the appearance detail that generation models require as conditioning. (2) We propose a generation-informed retrieval mechanism that selects reference frames based on their effectiveness for generative model conditioning, using character-gated retrieval and view-diversity constraints to ensure identity fidelity. (3) We design a multi-scale iterative refinement loop: per-shot judges that verify identity and setting fidelity, and a sequence-level critic that detects failures only visible in aggregate (repetitive shots in the B-roll sequence, character drift) and drives targeted regeneration.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了MemComposer, 一种生成B卷序列的系统, 我们的贡献有三个方面: (1)我们构建一个结构化的视觉内存,按实体(特征,设置,动作,道具)索引一个视频体,整合跨剪辑的身份,并保存生成模型作为条件所需的外观细节. (2) 我们建议建立一个世代知情的检索机制,根据基准对基因模型调节的有效性选择参考框架,利用字符定位检索和视图多样性的限制,确保身份忠诚。 (3)我们设计了一个多尺度的迭代完善循环:每个射击判断器,可以验证身份和设定忠诚度,以及一个序列级的批评器,它检测失败只可见于聚合(B-卷轴序列的重复射击,人物漂移),并驱动定向再生.

blocks.en: Together, these components form an integrated system where memory, retrieval, and generation reinforce each other. We evaluate MemComposer against previous B-roll editing methods that operate only over existing content, using user directives that are feasible from the source footage for fair comparison. MemComposer generates sequences that adhere to the user directive better than previous methods (94.5% win rate). It also produces B-roll that looks like it belongs in the same visual world as the captured content: in human evaluations, MemComposer is preferred over text-to-video with planning in 92.8% of cases. Notably, when compared to an approach for assembling real captured footage, users judged MemComposer  more visually aligned in 41.8% of comparisons. We also show qualitative results of MemComposer  in our companion video.
blocks.zh: 这些组件共同组成一个集成系统,使内存,检索和生成相互强化. 我们对照先前的B-roll编辑方法评价MemComposer,这些方法只运行于现有内容,使用源片段中可行的用户指令进行公平比较. MemComposer生成比以往方法(94.5%的胜率)更符合用户指令的序列. 它还产生B-roll,看起来它和捕捉到的内容一样属于同一个视觉世界:在人类评价中,MemComposer比文本到视频更受青睐,92.8%的案例中有规划. 值得注意的是,与收集真实的摄像头的方法相比,用户认为MemComposer在41.8%的比较中比对了更多的视觉效果。 我们还在相伴视频中展示了MemComposer的质量结果.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Retrieval augmented generation for images conditions a diffusion model on retrieved visual references to enable generation of specific entities.
Re-Imagen ( Chen et al., 2023 ) introduced the idea.
Subsequent work refined retrieval granularity ( Yuan et al., 2025a ) , added reactivity to generation failures ( Shalev-Arkushin et al., 2026 ) , and personalized retrieval to user preferences ( Ling et al., 2026 ) .
These methods operate per-image, retrieve from generic databases without entity indexing, and cannot ensure that an entity generated in one output is the same in the next.
In video generation, retrieval supplies motion or structure rather than appearance. RAGME ( Peruzzo et al., 2025 ) injects retrieved temporal dynamics into a text-to-video model.
Animate-A-Story ( He et al., 2024 ) and DreamRunner ( Wang et al., 2026b ) retrieve for depth maps or motion LoRA priors, while character identity is handled by per-subject optimization decoupled from the retrieval stage entirely.
Most relevant is ViMax ( Huang et al., 2025 ) which retrieves references from a pool of self-generated portraits.
RAG has also been applied to video understanding ( Ren et al., 2026 ; Jeong et al., 2025 ) , where retrieval optimizes for information content rather than generative conditioning.
Across all these settings, retrieval targets generic corpora, and no system retrieves appearance-preserving references from a user’s own footage to condition generation.
blocks.zh:
检索增强图像生成条件,在检索到的视觉参考物上建立一个传播模型,以便能够生成特定实体。
Re-Imagen(Chen等人,2023年)提出了这个想法.
随后的作品精炼了检索颗粒性(Yuan等人,2025a),增加了生成故障的反活性(Shalev-Arkushin等人,2026年),以及用户偏好的个人化检索(Ling等人,2026年).
这些方法操作每个图像,在没有实体索引的情况下从通用数据库中检索,不能确保一个产出中产生的实体在下一个产出中是相同的.
在视频生成中,检索提供运动或结构而不是外观. RAGME(Peruzzo等人,2025年)将检索的时间动态注入文本到视频模型。
Animate-A-Story(He等人,2024年)和DreamRunner(Wang等人,2026年b)为深度地图或运动LORA前传检索,而人物身份则通过每个主体优化处理,完全脱离检索阶段.
最相关的是ViMax(Huang等人,2025年),它从一池自生肖像中检索参考文献.
RAG也被应用于视频理解(Ren等人,2026年;Jeong等人,2025年),其中的检索优化了信息内容而不是基因调节.
在所有这些设置中,检索都针对通用的corpora,没有系统从用户自己的镜头中检索到保留外观的引用到条件生成.

blocks.en:
Maintaining consistent characters across shots is a central challenge in long-form video generation.
Storyboard systems approach this by sharing appearance tokens across frames ( Dinkevich et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , propagating identity forward via causal DiT conditioning ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , injecting character embeddings ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026a ) , fine-tuning per-character LoRAs ( Gong et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) , or tracking world state ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Jain et al., 2025 ; Mondal et al., 2026 ) .
These methods work well but require a manually curated set of images per character.
Multi-agent director systems ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) focus on narrative planning via LLM orchestration, but character identity is derived from text descriptions or generated portraits, not from visual references.
Memory-based approaches offer a different strategy: VideoMemory ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) and StoryMem ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) maintain banks of generated keyframes, and MovieDreamer ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) learns autoregressive priors over visual tokens.
But this memory is built from a system’s own outputs or generic video banks.
Finally, identity-preserving T2V/I2V models ( Yuan et al., 2025b ; Wei et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) produce faithful single clips from provided references but generate each clip in isolation with no corpus-level memory or retrieval.
None of these families of methods operate over a large user corpus, and none ask which frames from that corpus will most effectively condition generation.
blocks.zh:
在长式视频生成中,保持各镜头的一致角色是中心挑战.
故事板系统通过跨帧共享外观标志来接近这一点(Dinkevich等人,2026年;Zhou等人,2024年),通过因果DiT条件(Huang等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年a)向前传播身份. (Ma等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2026年a),细化每个特征的LORAs(Gong等人,2023年;Wang等人,2025年b),或跟踪世界状态(Hu等人,2024年;Jain等人,2025年;Mondal等人,2026年).
这些方法运作良好,但要求每个角色有一套手工整理的图像。
多代理导演系统(Lin et al., 2024; Xu et al., 2024)通过LLM管弦乐专注于叙事规划,但人物身份来源于文字描述或生成的肖像,而非视觉参考.
基于记忆的方法提供了一个不同的策略:VideoMemory(周某1等人,2026b)和StoryMem(张某1等人,2025年)维持生成键框的库,MovieDreamer(赵某1等人,2024年)学习自旋前传而非视觉符号.
但这种记忆是通过系统本身的输出或通用视频库构建的.
最后,保存身份的T2V/I2V型号(袁等人,2025年b; Wei等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2024年;Wang等人,2026年a)从提供的参考文献中产生忠实的单片片段,但每个片段单独生成,没有实体级记忆或检索.
这些方法的家族没有一个在大量用户群中运作,也没有人问从这些用户群中找到哪些框架将最有效地限制生成。

blocks.en:
Editors today source B-roll through retrieval or generation, never both at once grounded in the same visual world.
Works like B-Script ( Huber et al., 2019 ) , Transcript to Video ( Xiong et al., 2022 ) , EditDuet ( Sandoval-Castaneda et al., 2025 ) , and AutoCut ( Zhou et al., 2026c ) automate B-roll assembly by retrieving and arranging existing clips from video collections into coherent timelines.
However, they cannot produce a shot that was never filmed.
Vidmento ( Yeh et al., 2026 ) takes a step further, using generative video to fill narrative gaps in a user’s timeline by conditioning each new clip on its immediate neighbors (the previous and next shot) to achieve local continuity. This local conditioning suffices for bridging adjacent scenes but does not build a persistent representation of characters or settings across the project.
We target this gap and generate B-roll that is grounded in specific characters, settings, and visual style of a given source footage, with retrieval and generation operating jointly over a structured entity memory rather than over timeline neighbors alone.
blocks.zh:
今天的编辑器通过检索或生成源B-roll,从未同时在同一个视觉世界中扎根.
B-Script(Huber等人,2019年),Transcript to Video(Xiong等人,2022年),EditDuet(Sandoval-Castaneda等人,2025年),AutoCut(Zhou等人,2026年c)等作品将B-roll组装自动化,从视频集中检索并安排现有的片段,使其达到一致的时间表.
然而,他们不能拍摄从未拍摄过的镜头。

blocks.en: 3. MemComposer for Memory-Guided B-roll Generation
blocks.zh: 3个 内存引导 B 卷生成器

blocks.en:
Generating B-roll faithful to a user’s video collection 𝒱 \mathcal{V} entails grounding every shot in the visual world of 𝒱 \mathcal{V} : characters, settings, and style, even in configurations that do not exist in the corpus.
Given a collection 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , user request U U , and target duration T T , we seek to generate a sequence of B-roll { ℬ 1 , … , ℬ N } \{\mathcal{B}^{1},\dots,\mathcal{B}^{N}\} .
Our key observation is that modern video generators already accept the right interface for this task: given a text prompt p v ​ i ​ d i p_{vid}^{i} and a set of reference frames ℱ i \mathcal{F}^{i} , a video model 𝒢 v ​ i ​ d \mathcal{G}_{vid} produces a clip ℬ i = 𝒢 v ​ i ​ d ​ ( p v ​ i ​ d i , ℱ i ) \mathcal{B}^{i}=\mathcal{G}_{vid}(p_{vid}^{i},\mathcal{F}^{i}) . The challenge is then to produce the right prompt and reference frames for each shot; ones that will cause the generator to produce footage visually grounded in 𝒱 \mathcal{V} . This factoring drives our method, MemComposer  (see Figure 2 ), a system with three stages:
we (1) build a memory ℳ \mathcal{M} of 𝒱 \mathcal{V} offline (§ 3.1 ), (2) use memory ℳ \mathcal{M} to plan and retrieve the reference frames ℱ i \mathcal{F}^{i} for each B-roll ℬ i \mathcal{B}^{i} (§ 3.2 ), and (3) generate the sequence using a shot-level dual judge and a sequence-level critic that automatically assess and refine the sequence (§ 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.1. Memory Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1. 记忆建筑

blocks.en: We seek to build a memory ℳ \mathcal{M} of the collection 𝒱 \mathcal{V} . Unlike conventional RAG systems that index moments relevant to visual understanding tasks such as VQA, the primary goal of the memory construction stage is to distill raw, temporally redundant video into a dense, entity-centric visual reference bank comprising characters and settings usable for grounding generation. To achieve this, our approach operates in three steps. First, collection analysis extracts structural metadata and temporal boundaries to summarize the available content. Second, frame selection aggressively prunes the video down to a high-quality subset of reference frames that balance setting context with view-diverse character appearances. Finally, we produce global character sheets that resolve local character detections across discrete clips into unified identities, ensuring generative consistency regardless of where the character appears in the source material. Note that memory ℳ \mathcal{M} is built once per collection and reused across all subsequent requests.
blocks.zh: 我们试图建立收藏 V\ mathcal{M} 的记忆 。 与索引与VQA等视觉理解任务相关的瞬间的传统RAG系统不同,内存构建阶段的首要目标是将原始的,时间上冗余的视频蒸馏成一个密集的,以实体为中心的视觉参考库,由可供地面生成的字符和设置组成. 为了实现这一目标,我们的方法分三个步骤运作。 首先,收集分析提取结构元数据和时间界限,以总结现有内容. 第二,框架选择将视频粗略地推向一个高质量的参考框架子集,在设置上下文与视图多样性字符外观之间保持平衡。 最后,我们制作全球人物表,将各个离散片段的局部人物检测解为统一身份,确保基因一致性,无论人物出现在源材料中何处. 注意, M\ mathcal{M} 内存是每次收集一次后再用于所有后续请求。

blocks.en:
For each clip v ∈ 𝒱 v\in\mathcal{V} , we use a vision-language model (VLM) to extract structured metadata including a clip summary, props, locations, and actions. Crucially, when extracting character information, we explicitly decouple permanent traits (e.g., core facial structure, ethnicity, build) from transient traits (e.g., clothing, accessories, momentary expressions). By embedding this permanent/transient distinction directly into the memory structure, our system is later able to enforce strict identity consistency across generated shots while still allowing for narrative-driven contextual changes (§ 3.3 ).
Per-clip records are aggregated into a collection-level summary S S describing the notable characters, settings, props, and actions in collection 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , which provides global context about what content is available in the collection.
blocks.zh:
对于每个剪辑 v QQ V\in\ mathcal{V},我们使用一个视觉语言模型(VLM)来提取结构化的元数据,包括剪辑摘要,道具,位置,和行动. 关键是,在提取人物信息时,我们明确将永久特征(如核心面部结构,种族,建构)与瞬间特征(如衣物,配件,瞬间表达)脱钩. 通过将这种永久/短暂的区分直接嵌入内存结构,我们的系统后来能够在生成的镜头中实施严格的身份一致性,同时仍然允许由叙事驱动的背景变化(第3.3节).
每张clip记录被汇总为收藏级摘要S,描述收藏V\mathcal{V}中的显著字符,设置,道具,以及动作,该集合提供了收藏中有哪些内容的全局背景.

blocks.en:
A single frame rarely serves both identity and setting equally well.
For instance, an extreme close-up carries rich facial detail but little setting context, while a wide establishing shot captures the environment but provides limited identity detail.
Frame selection must therefore balance these competing needs.
We allocate a per-clip frame budget b ( v ) = ⌈ d ( v ) / ρ ⌉ b^{(v)}=\lceil d^{(v)}/\rho\rceil to keep the memory ℳ \mathcal{M} compact, where d ( v ) d^{(v)} is the duration of clip v v in seconds, and ρ \rho is a target seconds per frame. We then split this budget between character- and setting-supporting frames within each clip.

单一框架很少能同时为身份和设定提供同样好的服务。
例如,一个极端的特写带有丰富的面部细节,但设置背景很少,而广义的建立镜头捕捉环境,但提供有限的身份细节.
因此,框架选择必须平衡这些相互竞争的需求。

blocks.en:
We uniformly sample frames across the clips and use a VLM to score each frame for face quality and setting quality on a scale of 1-10, and assign a view-type label (e.g., frontal, profile, full-body) for any detected face. For clips containing characters (as determined by the clip-level analysis), we allocate half of the budget to face frames and half to setting frames. We filter using the face quality score, non-maximum suppression, and view-type diversification. For clips without characters, we filter based on the setting score.
The retained frames across all clips form ℐ \mathcal{I} , with corresponding embeddings 𝒵 = ℰ ⁡ ( ℐ ) \mathcal{Z}=\mathcal{E}(\mathcal{I}) using an off-the-shelf multimodal encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} .
See the appendix for more details on the filtering process.

blocks.en: Per-clip metadata identifies characters within each clip but treats every clip independently, so the same person can appear under different local IDs across clips and a character query has no way to disambiguate cross-clip correspondences. We resolve identity by building a character sheet that consolidates the discovered characters. The sheet can be referenced at inference, allowing users to specify target characters.

Low-confidence clusters with fewer than 2 frames are discarded. Wrong faces can still leak into the clusters near the threshold, so we apply a verification pass where each face is compared against that cluster’s highest quality face, and any faces below a similarity threshold are filtered out. blocks.en: 3.2. Planning and Reference Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.2. 规划和参考检索

blocks.en: The goal of the retrieval stage is to bridge the gap between the user’s high-level text directive and the visual conditioning required by generative models. A text prompt alone is insufficient to guarantee that a specific character or location from the corpus will be faithfully reproduced. Therefore, our approach divides this problem into two tasks. First, narrative and assembly planning acts as an automated storyboard artist, decomposing the user’s request into a structured, shot-by-shot sequence with assigned camera movements and durations. Second, reference retrieval acts as a visual researcher, querying the previously constructed memory bank to pull the exact frames needed to visually anchor each shot, prioritizing identity preservation and view diversity over semantic similarity.
blocks.zh: 检索阶段的目标是缩小用户高级文本指令与基因模型所需的视觉条件之间的差距. 单凭文本就不足以保证从诉讼文书中忠实地复制具体特征或地点。 因此,我们的做法将这一问题分为两项任务。 首先,叙事和装配规划充当一个自动化的故事板艺术家,将用户的要求分解成结构化的逐一拍摄的序列,并配有指定的镜头动作和持续时间. 第二,参考检索起到视觉研究者的作用,查询先前构建的内存库,以拉动每个镜头的视觉锚定所需的精确帧,将身份保存和查看多样性放在语义相似性之上.

blocks.en: We use an LLM to decompose the user request into a detailed shot plan. We separate this into a two-stage process because narrative and cinematography require different reasoning: what the story needs (which characters, setting, how long) should be decided before how to “film” it (actions, camera motion). Coupling them in a single pass causes the LLM to sacrifice story progression for visual appeal or vice versa.
blocks.zh: 我们用LLM把用户请求分解成一个详细的射击计划. 我们把这分为两个阶段,因为叙事和电影需要不同的推理:故事需要什么(人物、设定、时间),然后才能决定如何“电影”(动作、相机动作)。 将它们连成一个通道,使得LLM为了视觉吸引力或者反之亦然牺牲故事进展.

blocks.en: The narrative planner receives the user request U U , target duration T T , and global context from memory ( S , C ) (S,C) , and outputs a shot plan. Each shot description π i \pi^{i} specifies which character appears, retrieval queries for those characters and the setting, a keyframe generation prompt p i ​ m ​ g i p_{img}^{i} , and a duration d i d^{i} (with ∑ d i = T \sum d^{i}=T ). Retrieval queries are constrained to permanent visual identifiers (e.g., facial structure for characters, architecture for settings) rather than transient states (e.g., clothing, lighting). This decouples identity from state at retrieval time: frames of a character or setting can be retrieved and used as visual references for shots that depict them in different clothing or lighting than the retrieved frames showed.

blocks.en: The assembly planner then takes the narrative outline and assigns cinematic details, including shot type (e.g., close-up, medium, wide), camera motion (e.g., static, pan, orbit), and a video generation prompt p v ​ i ​ d i p_{vid}^{i} , by applying guidelines derived from film editing principles (e.g., Walter Murch’s “Rule of Six”). The assembly planner may also adjust shot durations slightly for pacing. The final assembled plan Π \Pi drives both retrieval and generation downstream.

Each query q q , whether character or setting, is embedded using the same multimodal encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} from § 3.1 and ranked against candidate frames via cosine similarity sim ⁡ ( ℰ ⁡ ( q ) , z ) \mathrm{sim}(\mathcal{E}(q),z) for z ∈ 𝒵 z\in\mathcal{Z} . First, character-gated retrieval restricts each character query to the verified frame pool ℐ c \mathcal{I}_{c} for character c c . Second, per-character queries q c ​ h ​ a ​ r i , c q_{char}^{i,c} are ranked and selected separately from the top- k k candidates above a similarity floor, allowing up to two frames per character under a view-diversity rule that prioritizes a frontal view when available. The final set of frames forms the per-shot reference ℱ i \mathcal{F}^{i} .

blocks.en: 3.3. B-Roll Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3. B-Roll一代公司

blocks.en: The goal of the generation stage is to synthesize the final video sequence while adhering to the assembled shot plan Π \Pi and preserving the visual identity of the source collection 𝒱 \mathcal{V} through the retrieved reference sets { ℱ i } i = 1 N \{\mathcal{F}^{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} . Since high-fidelity video generation is computationally expensive, we decouple the generation process into two stages. First, we synthesize a sequence of text-anchored representative keyframes to ensure shot-to-shot continuity. We then evaluate and refine these keyframes through an automated multi-scale feedback loop that checks both local shot quality and global sequence coherence. Only after the keyframe sequence satisfies these constraints do we render the final video clips.

blocks.en: Reference frames retrieved for a single shot typically come from clips in which the character appears under different clothing, accessories, and lighting. Additionally, unlike curated single-subject images that prior reference-based generation methods typically use for grounding, real corpus frames often carry extraneous people, props, and background detail. Passing these frames directly to 𝒢 i ​ m ​ g \mathcal{G}_{img} with prompt p i ​ m ​ g i p_{img}^{i} requires the model to infer which attributes from each reference frame should transfer to the generated keyframe.

blocks.en: 4. Experiments
blocks.zh: 4. 实验

blocks.en: We implement MemComposer using Gemini 3 Flash for memory construction and narrative planning, Gemini 3.1 Pro for visual judges and critics, and Veo 3.1 for video generation. We provide implementation details: specific model variants, embedding architectures, hyperparameters, and prompts, in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们使用双子座3 Flash来实施记忆构建和叙事规划,双子座3.1 Pro用于视觉评委和评论家,Veo 3.1用于视频生成. 我们提供实施细节:附录中的具体模型变体、嵌入结构、超参数和提示。

blocks.en: 4.1. Baselines
As discussed in Section 2 , no prior method addresses corpus-grounded B-roll generation. We thus set up two baselines:
blocks.zh: 正如第2节所讨论的那样,任何先前的方法都无法处理基于生物体的B卷生成。 因此,我们确定了两个基准:

blocks.en: This baseline generates the sequence from the user request U and target duration T, without access to the user’s video collection 𝒱 \mathcal{V} . Since Veo 3.1 generates short clips, we use a single-stage planner, implemented with Gemini 3 Flash, to decompose U and T into a sequence of shot descriptions before generation. Each planned shot is generated with Veo 3.1. Unlike our method, this baseline does not split planning into narrative and assembly stages and does not use retrieved references or intermediate keyframes. It therefore serves as a baseline for what state-of-the-art text planning and video generation models can achieve without access to the user’s video collection.
blocks.zh: 此基线生成用户请求的 U 和目标持续时间 T 的序列, 无法访问用户的 V\ mathcal{V} 视频收藏 。 由于Veo 3.1生成短片段,我们使用一个与双子座3 Flash一起执行的单阶段计划器,在生成前将U和T分解成一个镜头描述的序列. 每个计划镜头都与Veo 3.1生成. 与我们的方法不同,这一基线没有将规划分为叙事和组装阶段,也没有使用检索的参考文献或中间键框. 因此,它可作为基线,用以衡量在不访问用户的视频收藏的情况下,最新的文本规划和视频生成模型能够实现哪些目标。

blocks.en: An agentic editing framework that retrieves and assembles real clips from a user’s video collection based on a text request. blocks.en: 4.2. Evaluation Dataset and Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2. 评价数据集和计量

blocks.en: We use the evaluation dataset from EditDuet ( Sandoval-Castaneda et al., 2025 ) , consisting of 5 documentary projects with raw footage from EditStock ( EditStock, 2026 ) and manually annotated high-level user requests describing the B-roll sequences in the final cuts from each project. We randomly sample up to 9 user requests per project (39 in total), spanning diverse styles (e.g., serene, nature-oriented vs. fast-paced, action-filled), with an average target duration of 19.1s. EditDuet also optionally accepts audio transcript as input, which we provide to EditDuet where available in the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自EditDuet(Sandoval-Castaneda等人,2025年)的评价数据集,由5个文件项目组成,其中的原始镜头来自EditStock(EditStock,2026年),并手动附加说明的高端用户请求,描述每个项目最终削减中的B卷序列. 我们随机抽取每个项目多达9个用户请求(共计39个),风格多样(如静态,面向自然与快速节奏,充填动作),平均目标持续时间为19.1s. 编辑 Duet 还可以选择接受音频记录稿作为输入,我们提供在数据集中可用的编辑 Duet 。

blocks.en: We evaluate performance across three dimensions: (1) Duration Control: We report the absolute difference | Δ ​ T | |\Delta T| (in seconds) between the output sequence duration and target duration T T . (2) Prompt Adherence: We conduct a forced-choice A/B user study to evaluate narrative fidelity. We display the input text request U U alongside a pair of generated B-roll sequences (ours and a baseline, in randomized order) and ask evaluators: “Which video better represents the text prompt above?" (3) Visual Alignment: We conduct a second A/B user study to evaluate corpus fidelity. To familiarize the evaluators with the visual world of the source footage, we display a static reference board of 5–6 images taken from the project’s EditStock overview page. We then ask: “Which video better fits in with the reference frame collection shown above?"
blocks.zh: 我们评价三个方面的业绩: (1) 期限控制: 我们报告输出序列持续时间与目标持续时间T的绝对差异。 (2) 迅速加入: 我们进行强制选择A/B用户研究,以评估叙事忠诚。 我们用一对生成的B卷序列(我们和基线,按随机顺序排列)同时显示输入文本请求U U, 并询问评估者:“哪段视频能更好地代表上面的文本?” (3)视觉对齐: 我们进行了第二次A/B用户研究,以评估人身忠诚。 为了让评价者熟悉源片段的视觉世界,我们展示了一个由5-6幅图片组成的静态参考板,这些图片取自项目EditStock概览页。 然后,我们问:“哪部录像更符合上述参考框架的收集工作?”

blocks.en: For the A/B studies we recruited 286 participants via Prolific, who provided on average 5 unique ratings per video pair. We opted for A/B testing, a common protocol for generation, over Likert scale evaluations due to the challenges of calibrating scores across participants. We report win rate , the percentage of users preferring MemComposer  over the alternative approach.
blocks.zh: 对于A/B研究,我们通过Prolific招聘了286名参与者,平均每对视频提供5个独特的收视率。 我们选择了A/B测试,即一个共同的生成协议,而不是Imert规模评价,因为各参与者的分数难以校准。 我们报告胜率, 用户比其他方法更喜欢计算器的百分比。

blocks.en: 4.3. Results
Table 1 summarizes our quantitative results. MemComposer achieves better duration control and prompt adherence while remaining visually aligned with the source footage.
blocks.zh: 表1概述了我们的量化结果。 MemComposer在保持视像与源片段对齐的同时,实现了更好的持续时间控制和快速遵守.

blocks.en: MemComposer achieves near-perfect adherence to the target duration T T , with an average absolute error of just 0.12 ± 0.05 0.12\pm 0.05 seconds ( 0.8 % 0.8\% relative error). In contrast, EditDuet struggles with precise timing ( 4.77 ± 4.75 4.77\pm 4.75 seconds error) because it is bottlenecked by the lengths of the available retrieved raw clips. The T2V + Planner baseline also exhibits higher variance ( 1.26 ± 0.95 1.26\pm 0.95 seconds error), largely because failed video generations are excluded from the final sequence. In contrast, MemComposer can fall back to a still keyframe for the planned shot duration, enabling more reliable duration control even when generation fails.

T2V + Planner基线也显示出较高的差异(1.26± 0.95 1.26\pm 0.95秒错误),这主要是因为失败的视频世代被排除在最终序列之外. 相比之下,MemComposer可以在计划拍摄持续时间中回到一个仍然按键的框架,即使在生成失败时也能使持续时间控制更加可靠.

blocks.en: MemComposer overwhelmingly outperforms both baselines in fulfilling the user’s text directive. Against EditDuet, our full system achieves a 94.5% win rate. Because EditDuet can only assemble existing footage, it fundamentally fails when a user requests a specific action or perspective that was never captured. MemComposer’s generative pipeline gracefully overcomes this limitation. Furthermore, MemComposer achieves a 60% win rate over the T2V + Planner baseline. Although both methods synthesize new content, MemComposer’s keyframe chaining and iterative feedback ensures that the multi-shot sequence accurately reflects the prompt across temporal cuts without drifting.
blocks.zh: 在完成用户的文本指令方面,MemComposer压倒性地超过了两个基线。 反对EditDuet,我们整个系统实现94.5%的胜率. 因为EditDuet只能将已有的镜头组装起来,当一个用户请求一个从未捕捉到的动作或视角时,它根本失效. MemComposer的基因管道优雅地克服了这一限制。 此外,MemComposer在T2V + Planner基线上实现了60%的胜率. 虽然这两种方法都合成了新内容,但MemComposer的键框链式和迭代反馈确保了多镜头序列准确反映跨时断时速而不漂移.

blocks.en:
The primary goal of our system is to synthesize footage that reflects the user’s specific visual world. When compared to T2V + Planner, which generates purely from text without corpus grounding, human evaluators preferred MemComposer 92.8% of the time, validating the need for our memory and retrieval architecture.
EditDuet is a stricter baseline: it constructs sequences directly using footage in the user’s collection, which we would expect to have a natural advantage in visual alignment. Even so, evaluators preferred MemComposer’s generated sequences in 41.8% of comparisons, indicating that generation quality together with collection-grounded memory and retrieval can narrow the perceived alignment gap between generated B-roll and real captured footage.

blocks.en: 4.4. Ablation Study

blocks.en: We ablate the three stages of MemComposer to isolate their contributions. Each variant modifies one stage and leaves the rest in its default configuration. Table 2 reveals several key insights:
blocks.zh: 我们放弃三个阶段的 " 计算器 " 来孤立他们的贡献。 每个变体都会修改一个阶段,其余部分会留在它的默认配置中. 表2显示了若干关键见解:

blocks.en: Replacing our frame selection with naive sampling strategies degrades visual alignment. When compared to Uniform sampling or Scene-detected boundary frames, human evaluators preferred MemComposer’s full memory for visual alignment (78.2% and 83.3% win rates, respectively), confirming our hypothesis that generative models require specific, high-quality conditioning frames of entities rather than just semantically relevant moments. Also, using unfiltered uniformly sampled frames to build the character sheet ( Uniform + C C ) also led to a drop in visual alignment.
blocks.zh: 用天真的采样策略取代我们的帧选择会降低视觉对齐性. 与统一采样或场景探测边界框架相比,人类评估人员更喜欢MemComposer的全内存进行视觉对齐(分别是78.2%和83.3%),证实了我们的假设,即基因模型需要特定、高质量的实体调节框架,而不只是模拟相关的时刻。 另外,使用未过滤的统一抽样框架来构建字符表(United + C C)也导致视觉对齐下降.

blocks.en: Replacing our retrieval module with Caption-RAG (text-text similarity search using clip descriptions and taking the mid-frame from matching clips) often retrieves frames that semantically match the prompt’s action but feature the wrong entity, resulting in a sharp drop in both prompt adherence (63.4% win rate for MemComposer) and visual alignment (54.3%). Removing the character ID gate ( No char. ID gate ) also results in a drop in both Prompt adherence and Visual alignment, showing that strict entity-gating is necessary to prevent the generator from mixing identities.
blocks.zh: 用 Caption-RAG (使用剪辑描述的文本文本相似性搜索, 从匹配剪辑中取出中框) 来取代我们的检索模块, 经常检索出与及时动作相匹配的帧, 移除字符ID门(No. char. ID gate)也会导致快速遵守和视觉对齐的下降,表明严格的实体配对对于防止生成者混合身份是必要的.

blocks.en: Disabling the per-shot judges ( w/o judges ) reduced the system’s ability to maintain strict visual alignment (59.7% win rate for MemComposer), as the generator was allowed to pass localized identity failures into the final assembly. Disabling the sequence-level critic ( w/o critic ) hurt prompt adherence (65% win rate for MemComposer), demonstrating that while individual shots might be locally coherent, a global critic is required to catch narrative stalls, missed actions, or pacing issues across the compiled sequence.

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MemComposer, a system for generating collection-grounded B-roll. MemComposer  overcomes the scalability limits of manual curation by constructing an offline, entity-centric memory from raw footage that explicitly decouples permanent from transient traits. This enables generation-informed retrieval and a multi-scale iterative generation loop. By ensuring visual anchors are optimal for video generation conditioning, MemComposer consistently produces cohesive sequences that preserve the identity of the user’s visual world. Our user study shows that our method outperforms text-to-video and retrieval-only baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了MemComposer, 一个生成基于收集的B卷的系统。 MemComposer通过从原始镜头中构建一个离线的,以实体为中心的内存,将永久与瞬时特征明确脱钩,从而克服了手动曲解的可伸缩性限制. 这样可以进行世代知情的检索和多尺度的迭代生成循环. MemComposer通过确保视觉主播是视频生成调制的最佳方式,不断生成保护用户视觉世界特征的凝聚序列. 我们的用户研究表明,我们的方法超过了文本到视频和只检索的基线。

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: While MemComposer demonstrates strong performance, it is subject to the limitations illustrated in Figure 6 . First, because our multi-scale critic operates exclusively on generated keyframes to maintain computational feasibility, the system lacks a video-level feedback loop. Consequently, while individual shots are visually aligned, the cuts between clips can occasionally feel disjointed since motion patterns and compositions are not explicitly forced to bridge smoothly across boundaries. Incorporating video-level judges could address this, though at a significantly higher computational cost. However, controlling the overall pacing/dynamics of the sequence is an open question on its own.
blocks.zh: 虽然MemComposer表现出强效,但受图6所示限制。 首先,因为我们的多尺度评论家完全在生成的键框上运作,以保持计算可行性,所以系统缺乏视频级反馈循环. 因此,虽然个别镜头是视线对齐的,但剪辑之间的切口偶尔会感到脱节,因为运动模式和组成并不明显地被迫跨越边界顺利过渡。 纳入视频级法官可以解决这一问题,尽管计算成本要高得多。 然而,控制序列的整体速度/动力学本身就是一个有待解决的问题.

blocks.en: Second, our pipeline’s final fidelity is inherently bound by the capabilities of the underlying video generation model. We observe that current models occasionally struggle with complex physics and rapid actions, leading to implausible motions or localized hallucinations. Additionally, we trim clips during assembly because Veo is constrained to only producing 4/6/8 second outputs, depending on the conditioning mode.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们的管道最终的忠诚性本身就受到基本视频生成模型的能力的约束。 我们观察到,目前的模型偶尔会与复杂的物理和快速行动发生斗争,导致不可信的运动或局部幻觉. 此外,在装配过程中我们修剪剪剪辑片段,因为Veo受限制只能产生4/6/8的二次输出,这取决于调制模式.

blocks.en: Third, the current decomposition of characters/settings may not cover the full granularity of controllable assets. We evaluated a few examples using specific objects/props within the collections and found that the quality of the results depends on how well the memory construction stage captured the object. For example, more prominent/frequently observed objects were often saved, but smaller/infrequently seen objects were sometimes missed, highlighting the need for more explicit filtering during the memory stage.
blocks.zh: 三,当前字符/设置的分解可能无法涵盖可控资产的全部颗粒性. 我们利用收集中的特定对象/道具评价了几个例子,发现结果的质量取决于内存构造阶段对对象的捕捉程度. 例如,比较突出/经常观察到的物体经常被保存,但较小/很少见到的物体有时被错过,突出表明需要在内存阶段进行更明确的过滤.

blocks.en: Appendix B Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 附录B 道德考虑

blocks.en: Because MemComposer  utilizes face recognition and video generation to synthesize new actions for real individuals, it carries the risk of being misused to create non-consensual deepfakes or misrepresent individuals. Our system is explicitly designed as a creative editing tool for users operating over their own personal or licensed media collections. To mitigate misuse, such frameworks should be paired with robust origin-tracing protocols, such as invisible watermarking, and should be deployed alongside standard commercial safeguards that filter malicious generation prompts.
blocks.zh: 由于MemComposer利用面部识别和视频生成来综合对真实个体的新行动,它有被滥用的风险,以制造未经同意的深层假象或歪曲个人. 我们的系统被明确设计成一个创造性的编辑工具,供用户在自己的个人或特许媒体收藏中操作. 为了减少滥用,这种框架应配以强力的原产地追踪协议,如隐形水标记,并应与过滤恶意生成诱因的标准商业保障措施一起部署。

blocks.en: D.2. Baseline Implementations
blocks.zh: D.2. 基线执行

blocks.en: To create a fair comparison for the T2V baseline, we implement a single-stage planner derived from our proposed two-stage planner using Gemini 3 Flash (prompt provided in Figure 10 ). We bypass the keyframe generation stage entirely and directly input the generated video prompts to Veo 3.1.
blocks.zh: 为了对T2V基线进行公平比较,我们采用双子座3 Flash(即时图10),从我们提议的两阶段规划员中产生一个单阶段规划员。 我们绕过键框生成阶段 完全和直接输入生成的视频提示 到Veo 3.1。

blocks.en: Figure 10 . VLM prompt for the Text2Video planner.
blocks.zh: 图10. Text2Video规划器的VLM提示.

blocks.en: We follow the original implementation as described by ( Sandoval-Castaneda et al., 2025 ) , utilizing the same collection indexing and assembly protocols.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循(Sandoval-Castaneda等人,2025年)所述的最初执行情况,使用相同的收集索引和组装协议。

blocks.en: We experimented with alternative retrieval strategies, such as text-text similarity ( Caption-RAG ablation) but found that our proposed text-image similarity performed better. We did not try any learning-based retrieval approaches due to limited training data.
blocks.zh: 我们试用了其他检索策略,如文本的相似性(Caption-RAG explosion),但发现我们提议的文本图像相似性表现较好。 由于培训数据有限,我们没有尝试任何基于学习的检索方法。

blocks.en: During final video rendering, Veo 3.1 may occasionally fail to produce an output clip due to its built-in safety filters. When this occurs in our MemComposer pipeline, we gracefully degrade by inserting a static video clip of the successfully generated keyframe for the planned duration of that shot. Because the T2V baseline operates without intermediate keyframes, any clips blocked by filters in the baseline are simply omitted from its final assembled sequence.
blocks.zh: 在最后的视频渲染过程中,Veo 3.1由于内置的安全过滤器,偶尔可能无法产生输出剪辑. 当我们的MemComposer管道中发生这种情况时,我们通过插入一个静态的视频片段,将成功生成的密钥框固定在计划拍摄期间,从而优雅地降解。 由于T2V基线运行时没有中间键框,因此在基线中被滤波器屏蔽的任何片段都只是从其最终组装的序列中省略.
